# Northwest AEC — Marine & Mountain Building Science Specifications
> Authoritative technical specifications, Cascadia rainscreen engineering, seismic retrofits, and contractor execution standards for Marine Zone 4C & Zone 5 Mountain (WA, OR, ID, MT, AK).

Northwest AEC publishes peer-reviewed architectural and mechanical specifications covering rainscreens, continuous exterior insulation, seismic cripple-wall retrofits, mass timber, and WUI wildfire hardening.

## Technical Specifications (Clean Markdown)
- [Air-Sealing Exposed Craftsman Rafter Tails in Historic Pacific Northwest Bungalows](https://northwestaec.com/articles/air-sealing-exposed-craftsman-rafter-tails.md): Step-by-step building science tutorial for air-sealing and insulating open rafter tails and frieze blocks on 1900–1930s Pacific Northwest Craftsman homes.
- [Cross-Laminated Timber Exterior Envelope Weatherproofing: Vapor-Permeable WRBs & Mineral Wool](https://northwestaec.com/articles/clt-mass-timber-exterior-envelope-wrb.md): Hygrothermal engineering report detailing moisture protection for Cross-Laminated Timber (CLT) walls in Pacific Northwest Marine Zone 4C under ASTM E2178.
- [Crawlspace Encapsulation in the Pacific Northwest: Saturated Soils, Radon & Inversion Physics](https://northwestaec.com/articles/crawlspace-encapsulation-pacific-northwest.md): Technical engineering specification for closed conditioned crawlspace encapsulation under IRC R408.3 across high-precipitation Pacific Northwest maritime soils.
- [Step-by-Step Pacific Northwest Crawlspace Encapsulation & Radon Sealing Protocol](https://northwestaec.com/articles/crawlspace-encapsulation-steps.md): How to encapsulate a Pacific Northwest crawlspace: Step-by-step instructions for grading soil, installing 20-mil poly with double-sided butyl tape, and sealing foundation vents.
- [Ductless Mini-Splits vs. Electric Baseboards in the Pacific Northwest: Sizing, Defrost & Cost Analysis](https://northwestaec.com/articles/ductless-mini-splits-vs-electric-baseboards.md): Replacing Pacific Northwest electric baseboard heating with ductless mini-split heat pumps reduces electrical consumption by 50% to 60% through variable-capacity inverter compressors and automated demand-defrost logic.
- [Frost-Free Sillcock Installation: Pitch Angles & Anti-Siphon Freeze Defense](https://northwestaec.com/articles/frost-free-sillcock-installation-freeze-burst.md): Step-by-step engineering tutorial for installing and pitching frost-free outdoor hose bibbs to prevent catastrophic freeze bursts in Pacific Northwest winter cold snaps.
- [Heat Pump Defrost Cycles and Marine Climate Coil Icing: The Physics of 38°F Maritime Fog](https://northwestaec.com/articles/heat-pump-defrost-marine-climate-icing.md): Thermodynamic breakdown of air-source heat pump coil icing in Marine Zone 4C high-humidity winter air, contrasting timed vs. demand defrost logic and pan heaters.
- [Hillside French Drains and Retaining Wall Hydrostatic Pressure Relief in Cascadia Soils](https://northwestaec.com/articles/hillside-french-drain-hydrostatic-retaining-walls.md): Engineering teardown of hillside drainage systems, dimple-core geocomposite drainage boards, washed gravel relief bays, and gravity daylight exits in Marine Zone 4C.
- [Mountain Snow Load Roof Truss Engineering: 60 to 120 PSF Glulam & Cold-Roof Sizing](https://northwestaec.com/articles/mountain-snow-load-roof-truss-engineering.md): Structural engineering specification for residential roof trusses, timber purlins, and ventilated cold-roof assemblies under 60–120 PSF snow loads in Climate Zones 5/6.
- [Outboard Mineral Wool vs. Foam Rainscreens: Vapor Permeance & Wildfire Defense in Wet Climates](https://northwestaec.com/articles/outboard-mineral-wool-vs-foam-rainscreens.md): Comparative building science report analyzing continuous exterior insulation materials for Pacific Northwest envelopes, contrasting stone wool vs rigid foam.
- [How to Install a Cascadia Rainscreen: Sizing Furring Strips, Bug Screens & Flashing Protocol](https://northwestaec.com/articles/rainscreen-installation-furring-steps.md): How to install an exterior rainscreen cavity: Step-by-step instructions for fastening vertical furring strips, wrapping stainless bug screens, and integrating window flashing.
- [Rainscreen Siding Gaps: Sizing the 3/8-Inch to 3/4-Inch Capillary Cavity in Marine Zone 4C](https://northwestaec.com/articles/rainscreen-siding-cascadia-gap.md): Comparative building science specification for sizing ventilated rainscreen drainage cavities in high-precipitation Pacific Northwest climate zones under ASTM E2273.
- [Roof Moss Mitigation: Installing Zinc and Copper Strips Without Damaging Shingles](https://northwestaec.com/articles/roof-moss-mitigation-zinc-copper-strips.md): Step-by-step engineering tutorial for safely mitigating roof moss using continuous metallic zinc strips, oxygen bleach, and low-pressure sprayers.
- [Seismic Retrofit Cripple Wall Bracing & Foundation Bolting: Cascadia Subduction Defense](https://northwestaec.com/articles/seismic-retrofit-cripple-wall-bolting.md): Structural engineering specification for prescriptive seismic retrofitting under CEBC Appendix A3, detailing mudsill anchor bolting, cripple wall plywood sheathing, and shear transfer paths.
- [Step-by-Step Cripple Wall Bracing & Mudsill Bolting: The Cascadia Seismic Retrofit Walkthrough](https://northwestaec.com/articles/seismic-retrofit-cripple-wall-steps.md): How to seismically retrofit a Pacific Northwest home: Step-by-step instructions for bolting unanchored mudsills with Simpson UFP10 plates, installing structural CDX plywood shear walls, and nailing A35 framing anchors.
- [Sliding Glass Door Draft Weatherization: 5 High-Impact Retrofit Options](https://northwestaec.com/articles/sliding-glass-door-draft-weatherization-options.md): Technical listicle evaluating 5 engineered weatherization retrofits for drafty sliding glass patio doors in wet, windy Pacific Northwest coastal zones.
- [Standing Seam Metal Roofing in Cascadia Rain: Moss Resistance, Concealed Clips & Underlayments](https://northwestaec.com/articles/standing-seam-metal-roofing-cascadia-rain.md): Comparative engineering analysis of standing seam metal roofs vs architectural asphalt shingles in wet Pacific Northwest forest canopies under high-precipitation loads.
- [Triple-Pane vs. Double-Pane Windows in the Pacific Northwest: U-Factor 0.22 Marine Codes](https://northwestaec.com/articles/triple-pane-vs-double-pane-windows-marine-codes.md): Comparative thermodynamic analysis of triple-pane vs double-pane windows under Washington and Oregon energy codes, warm-edge composite spacers, and condensation resistance.
- [Unreinforced Masonry Chimney Bracing: Seismic Risk and Diagonal Steel Restraint](https://northwestaec.com/articles/unreinforced-masonry-chimney-bracing-seismic.md): Structural engineering analysis of unreinforced masonry (URM) chimney failures during Pacific Northwest earthquakes, detailing roof-plane steel diagonal bracing and brick stabilization.
- [Unvented Attic Condensation in Marine Zone 4C: Cold-Roof Rot & Air Sealing Physics](https://northwestaec.com/articles/unvented-attic-condensation-marine-zone-4c.md): Hygrothermal analysis of winter attic moisture condensation on cold roof sheathing in Pacific Northwest Marine Zone 4C, contrasting air sealing vs unvented spray foam roofs under IRC R806.5.
- [Washington Clean Buildings Act & Residential Electrification: Compliance & Rebate Stacking](https://northwestaec.com/articles/washington-clean-buildings-act-residential-electrification.md): Strategic policy and engineering guide to Washington Clean Buildings standards, building decarbonization, utility heat pump rebates, and federal tax credits.
- [Winterizing Off-Grid Cabin Water Lines: Gravity Drain Manifolds & Air Blowout Protocols](https://northwestaec.com/articles/winterizing-off-grid-cabin-water-lines-gravity-drain.md): Step-by-step engineering tutorial for completely draining and winterizing residential domestic water lines in sub-zero Pacific Northwest mountain cabins.
- [Wildland-Urban Interface (WUI) Wildfire Hardening: Ember-Resistant Eave Vents & Defensible Perimeters](https://northwestaec.com/articles/wui-wildfire-hardening-ember-resistant-eave-vents.md): Comprehensive engineering guide to residential wildfire hardening in the Pacific Northwest WUI under ASTM E2886 and IWUIC Chapter 5.
